name: zapdesk
description: ZapDesk — WhatsApp desktop local com disparo em massa e MCP

scripts.motor:compilar: cd motor && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o bin/zapdesk-motor ./cmd/zapdesk-motor
scripts.compartilhado:compilar: npm run compilar -w @zapdesk/cliente-motor && npm run compilar -w @zapdesk/automacao
scripts.test: npm run compartilhado:compilar && npm run runner:compilar && npm test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.tipos: npm run compartilhado:compilar && npm run tipos --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run motor:compilar && npm run compartilhado:compilar && npm run runner:compilar && npm run dev -w @zapdesk/app
